title: Drugs, Biotech & Longevity
businessQuestion: How does generative molecular design compress clinical trial cycle time and failure rates?
investorQuestion: Who owns target exclusivity and intellectual property in AI-generated biologics?
overview: The bulk of records sit at proof of concept — platform technologies still looking for a first clinical proof point. Company coverage is deep, so the sector is best read by modality (gene editing, delivery, AI discovery, cell therapy) rather than by indication. Timelines hinge on trials, manufacturing yield and reimbursement, not on software adoption curves.
